items.text: ComputationAttestor trait: attest(scope, inputs, algorithm, output, agent)->Attestation and verify(&Attestation)->VerificationResult as an EPR variant
ProofTier trait: required_proof(context)->ProofClass — implementation-defined judgment weighing stakes/spread/consensus-deficit/provability; trait does not enumerate signals
AttestationProof trait: class()->ProofClass and verify(&Attestation)->VerificationResult; pluggable proof primitives

AttestationContext carries minimum observables (source_epr_id, algorithm_id, computer_agent_id, scope, optional input_merkle_root + output_hash); implementations derive standing/contestation/coupling from DHT+storage; no policy encoded

ProofClass opaque; concrete proof primitives plug in: agent-signature, deterministic re-execution, zkML, multi-attestor confirmation; provenance anchored to ELOHIM token SettlementBridge verify_provenance (consumed, not redefined)
Witness tier (default, lightest): computer-agent signs inputs+output; trust cheapens compute when standing present + uncontested
Audit tier: Merkle-rooted inputs, pinned algorithm+version, hashed output; anyone re-executes; triggered by consensus deficit or rising stakes
Proof tier: cryptographic (zkML); asymmetric verify; high-stakes + real-contestation + too-nondeterministic-to-re-execute; feasible for clustering/tally today, LLM is research horizon
Confirmation tier: Proof + multi-attestor + mishpat-quorum; used when constitutional floors (tending/standing-immune classes) are touched
Station judged at attestation by four signal categories: Stakes / Spread / Consensus-deficit / Provability; provability can ceiling but never floor a station; default Witness, rigor opt-in via demand

Open: required_proof returns single class vs tier-floor (voluntary over-attestation); manifest schema extension linking floor-proximity to Confirmation; InputSet accommodating prompts+system-context; relation to existing AttestationSignal EPR; per-evaluator-projection attestation granularity; operational polarization-marker definition
